trigger: Direct vendor-format CMD with BATCH=YES returned -1073741819 (0xC0000005) without a report and without Python launching FACETS.
purpose: Change only BATCH=YES to visible BATCH=NO to test whether the hidden batch execution path causes the native crash.

decision_rule.nonempty_report: Localize the defect to FACETS hidden BATCH=YES mode and qualify visible BATCH=NO as a candidate operational workaround pending automation tests.
decision_rule.same_crash_no_report: The fault is broader than hidden mode; inspect command-line versus interactive file-open execution.

claim_boundary: Launch-mode diagnostic only; no project input or estimator endpoint is used.
